text_block_list.text:
...One day, right around the midway point of summer camp,
it happened.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kgh... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine.
My leg is just a little――"
choice_data_list: Don't move. Let me take a look!

text_block_list.text:
I noticed what looked like swelling on Lucky Lilac's ankle.
We decided to head straight to the hospital for a thorough examination—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the swelling in her ankle,
fortunately, it's not fatal
to her racing career.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"First, if you rest until the swelling goes down
and take care not to place excessive strain on it,
it should return to normal."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, there is one more thing.
Aside from the swelling, there is another matter we must keep in mind.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: One more thing...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...It is likely due to her period of maturity.
There are signs of rapid changes in Lucky Lilac's muscle mass and skeletal structure."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, if you don't adjust how you move to match your growth,
you may lose your physical balance
and place unexpected strain on your body."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Along with the swelling going down,
please keep this in mind as well.
"...After finishing the checkup at the hospital, I set up a meeting with Lucky Lilac at the training camp to discuss our future plans."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...I am truly, terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had consulted with you sooner,
Trainer, things wouldn't have—"
choice_data_list: There's no need for you to apologize right now.
You don't need to apologize right now.

text_block_list.text:
The fault lies with me as her trainer
for failing to notice the changes in her.
Besides, I can understand why she tried to join the summer training camp even if it meant ignoring her discomfort—
choice_data_list: ...We'll definitely run in the Shuka Sho, no matter what.
...We'll definitely run in the Shuka Sho, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer...—

"First, recovering from the swelling is our top priority.
In parallel, we need to formulate
a new training plan."

Adjusting meal nutritional values, improving gait analysis methods,
enhancing body composition data aggregation.
There is a mountain of tasks to tackle, but it is no hardship.

I believe in her. I know Lucky Lilac can
overcome this adversity and seize glory.
choice_data_list: Enduring and blooming beautifully — that's your specialty.
Enduring and blooming beautifully — that's your specialty, you know.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You really are good at this.
Getting me all hyped up, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...That's very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I'm off duty for a bit.
Can't be helped, but how should I spend the time...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (......Trainer today—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(......They didn't get mad at all.
In fact, they even said it was their own fault...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(As if that's true.
No matter how ya look at it, I was the one bein' childish.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (And yet, to say, "The one that blooms through endurance" is—)
âLala-chan?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
B-Buena-san?! When did you...ize?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry!
I heard you went to the clinic at lunch, so I came because I was worried, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you had such a warm look
on your face just now, you know?
...A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like,
would you want to hang out together today?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The swelling has gone down, so I'd like to go on a little trip to refresh myself.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, haven't you been busy coordinating everything lately, Trainer?
I think it's about time you took a break."

Hearing that, it's true I've been on the move
non-stop lately.
A break is necessary so I don't break down.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then.
Well, I've picked out a few destination candidates, so could you tell me which one catches your eye?

Among the candidates suggested by Lucky Lilac,
the one that caught my eye was—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...What a lovely view.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Plus, it's so quiet and peaceful...
Yeah. Plus, it's so quiet and peaceful...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You really can feel
the power of nature from this...
choice_data_list: I feel like I'm gonna doze off...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that might be a good idea.
Shall we take it easy for a bit?
And so, Lucky Lilac and I found comfort in the sound of the waves for a while—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, thanks for waiting!
One 'Explosive Numbing Mazesoba' and
one 'Scorching Arrabbiata'!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh dear~... It looks spicier than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Eating spicy food and working up a sweat
is supposed to be great for relieving stress too.
Let's enjoy ourselves to the fullest today."
After that, while panting and sweating from the heat, the two of us thoroughly enjoyed the spicy, delicious gourmet meal—
